name: mcp-osascript
description: Let Claude control your Mac — 12 typed tools for windows, menus, keyboard, clipboard, browser tabs, notifications.
long_description: MCP server for macOS automation via AppleScript and JXA. 12 typed tools with input validation and security guardrails. Features self-correcting menu clicks (when Claude picks the wrong menu item, the server returns what's actually there so Claude retries correctly), URL scheme allowlist, environment isolation, and process group kill. 41 integration tests.

tools.name: get_frontmost_app
tools.description: Get active app name and bundle ID

tools.name: get_browser_tabs
tools.description: List tabs in Safari, Chrome, or Arc

tools.name: app_menu
tools.description: List or click menu items in any app
